unmet_need_anchor.finding: pMMR-KRAS subgroup DFS HR=1.48 vs pMMR-DWT reference — worst prognosis in pMMR group on FOLFOX
unmet_need_anchor.implication: KRAS-mut pMMR patients have highest recurrence risk on FOLFOX with no approved targeted therapy

folfox_backbone_benchmark.finding: Stage III OS HR=0.80 (95%CI 0.65-0.97, P=0.023); 10-year update confirms HR=0.80 (P=0.016)
folfox_backbone_benchmark.implication: mFOLFOX6 backbone delivers ~20% OS improvement; BreAK CRC-001 control arm baseline

kras_mut_mss_historical_os_benchmark.finding: RAS-mut FOLFOX4 alone: OS median 20.2 months; panitumumab adds no benefit (HR=1.29 harm)
kras_mut_mss_historical_os_benchmark.implication: KRAS-mut MSS mCRC on mFOLFOX6 alone: ~20 month OS. STC-1010 must improve above this floor.

bevacizumab_arm_benchmark.finding: OS HR=0.817 (P=0.0032); prior bevacizumab subgroup: 12.5 vs 11.7 months (interaction P=0.57)
bevacizumab_arm_benchmark.implication: Bevacizumab adds ~1.4 month OS in second-line; BreAK CRC-001 bev arm adds this increment to mFOLFOX6

oracle_application: Classify MMR variants (N0147 pipeline, 0.957 AUROC) + expanded RAS (PRIME pipeline: KRAS+NRAS exon 2/3/4 + BRAF exon 15) for BreAK CRC-001 enrollment gating and subgroup stratification

data_gaps.n0147: Adjuvant Stage III only; KRAS exon 2 only (no expanded RAS); no immune/TME data
data_gaps.mosaic: Zero molecular data — no MSI/KRAS/RAS/BRAF; adjuvant not metastatic
data_gaps.prime: No MMR/MSI data; FOLFOX4 not mFOLFOX6; no bevacizumab arm; individual RAS exon HRs behind paywall
data_gaps.velour: Zero molecular data; second-line FOLFIRI not first-line mFOLFOX6; aflibercept not bevacizumab
